content: Transformation of BSWMD template modeling according to the AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules 41 of 47  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 86: AUTOSAR_RS_BSWModuleDescriptionTemplate Requirements on Basic Software Module Description Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: The XML representation for the BSWMD template SHALL be derived from its UML representation according to the AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules. Rationale: The experience and tools already available for the AUTOSAR Modeling SHALL be reused. Dependencies:  Use Case: The template for the BSWMD is similar to other templates already done with the AUTOSAR Metamodeling Guide. Supporting Material: AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules [5]
